//: Extends the repo base so the app is held to the same strictness as every package.
`paths` is the dependency-rule allowlist: the web app may read kit-shaped data and the
shared error/DTO types, and nothing else. It must not reach llm, retrieval or pipeline —
the browser talks to the API, never to a provider. `npm run typecheck` enforces this.
`coverage` is on the list for one reason: comparing two kits means deciding whether two
requirements from different postings are the same requirement, and that comparison already
exists there as deterministic token overlap. Re-implementing it here would mean a second
copy of the stopword list, and the two would drift. It reaches only contracts and kit, so
it brings no provider with it — which is the property this allowlist actually protects.
